title: ChatGPT: Everything you need to know about the AI-powered chatbot
description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.
author: Kyle Wiggers, Cody Corrall, Alyssa Stringer, Kate Park

title: Equity Live: From $300M seed rounds to data center builds, AI is feeling bubbly
description: The Equity crew was live at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025! Hosts Kirsten Korosec, Max Zeff, and Anthony Ha took over the Builders Stage on Monday morning to kick off the event with the question everyone’s asking: are we in an AI bubble?  Between valuations that have tripled in months, $300M seed rounds, and $100B commitments flying […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, Maxwell Zeff

title: AWS exceeds Wall Street’s expectations as demand for cloud infra remains high
description: AWS continues to see strong demand as companies gobble up its cloud infrastructure services in the age of AI.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Perplexity strikes multi-year licensing deal with Getty Images
description: Perplexity’s agreement with Getty appears to legitimize some of the startup’s previous use of Getty’s stock photos. Perplexity came under fire last year for a series of plagiarism accusations from several news organizations.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Tim Cook says Apple is open to M&A on the AI front
description: Apple CEO Tim Cook noted in the company's Q4 2025 earnings call that Apple was preparing to announce more AI partnerships like the one it has with OpenAI to integrate ChatGPT into Siri and Apple Intelligence.
author: Sarah Perez

title: YC alum Adam raises $4.1M to turn viral text-to-3D tool into AI copilot
description: After generating over 10 million social media impressions with the launch of its text-to-3D model app, Adam has raised a $4.1 million seed round to power its next steps.
author: Anna Heim

title: Reddit CEO says chatbots are not a traffic driver
description: Reddit doesn't see a lot of traffic coming from chatbot answers
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Nvidia expands AI ties with Hyundai, Samsung, SK, Naver
description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang is visiting South Korea to strengthen partnerships with Samsung, Hyundai, SK, and Naver, unveiling plans for AI-powered networks and next-generation intelligent systems.
author: Kate Park

title: Nvidia is reportedly investing up to $1B in Poolside
description: Nvidia is an existing investor in the AI company and participated in its $500 million Series A round in 2024.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Bevel raises $10M Series A from General Catalyst for its AI health companion
description: Bevel's AI health companion unifies data from wearables and daily habits across sleep, fitness, and nutrition into personalized insights.
author: Tage Kene-Okafor

title: Google partners with Ambani’s Reliance to offer free AI Pro access to millions of Jio users in India
description: U.S. tech giants increasingly view India as the next big frontier — a place to gather diverse data, refine models, and test AI use cases that could later scale across other emerging markets.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Figma acquires AI-powered media generation company Weavy
description: Figma said that Weavy will exist as a stand-alone product for now and that, in the future, it will be integrated with the Figma Weave brand, along with the rest of the Figma platform.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko is a big fan of agentic coding

title: Box CEO Aaron Levie on how AI is changing the enterprise SaaS landscape
description: He painted a picture of a future of enterprise software where the SaaS is used for the core business workflow, and then the agents ride on top of that.

title: ElevenLabs CEO says AI audio models will be ‘commoditized’ over time
description: ElevenLabs' founder Mati Staniszewski said that, in the short term, AI audio models were still the "biggest advantage and the biggest step change you can have today."

title: How AI labs use Mercor to get the data companies won’t share

description: With a market cap of $5 trillion, Nvidia is now worth more than the aggregated stock markets of all countries, apart from the United States, China and Japan.

title: Super Teacher is building an AI tutor for elementary schools — catch it at Disrupt 2025
description: Super Teacher’s app features animated tutors with AI-generated voices that guide students through interactive lessons. Students talk to the app using voice, like a conversation with a teacher.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: Mappa’s AI voice analysis helps you find the best job candidates and will show off its tech at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
description: Mappa's AI hiring platform can assess a candidate's behavior based on voice patterns, and aims to take some of the guesswork out of hiring.

description: CampusAI is an educational platform focused on making learning accessible to everyday people who want to bring AI into their everyday workflows, and a virtual ecosystem to connect like-minded people.

title: Sam Altman says OpenAI will have a ‘legitimate AI researcher’ by 2028
description: To achieve those goals, OpenAI is betting on two key strategies: continued algorithmic innovation and dramatically scaling up "test time compute" — essentially how long models spend thinking about problems.

title: Elloe AI wants to be the ‘immune system’ for AI — check it out at Disrupt 2025
description: Elloe AI promises a system capable of fact-checking AI outputs, making sure they don’t violate laws and regulations, and that they are safe for the users.
author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
